description: Amir Patel calls Stephanie Morris to accept her offer for a formal property valuation and adaptive reuse scenario analysis. He schedules a site visit and requests two deliverables: (1) current market value of the property as-is, and (2) a comparative scenario analysis across fuel-only operation, EV charging retrofit, and full adaptive reuse sale. No cash changes hands this tick. This is the initiation of a professional advisory engagement.

resources.detail: Stephanie provides initial consultation and schedules formal valuation. Amir provides site access, business financials, and property documentation. Valuation fee to be determined and settled in a subsequent tick.

relationship_effect.note: Amir is responding directly to Stephanie's tick 7 outreach. This increases trust and establishes a substantive advisory relationship.
